7.4.5 Functional unit
[SWS_Dem_01293]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04071
⌈If the API Dem_GetFunctionalUnitOfDTC is called and for the selected DTC a
functional unit value in DemDTCFunctionalUnit is configured, the Dem shall set the
value configured in DemDTCFunctionalUnit in the out parameter DTCFunction-
alUnit.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01294]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04071
⌈If the API Dem_GetFunctionalUnitOfDTC is called and for the selected DTC no
functional unit in DemDTCFunctionalUnit is configured, the Dem shall set a value of
0x00 in the out parameter DTCFunctionalUnit.⌋
caption: 7.4.5 Functional unit
